answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a distant comet: bright but carrying no proven mass. Standing grows across many epochs, each verified contribution adding a layer until a pearl of real reputation forms. Genuine contributors cultivate that pearl like a lotus rising from still water. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic comets fade while established holders keep their pearl.
